description.value: White Spot is BC's longest-running restaurant chain, founded in 1928 and widely regarded as a regional institution for its burger-forward menu built around 100% Canadian beef and locally sourced BC ingredients. The Burnaby Marine and Byrne location sits in the Market Crossing retail complex and offers full dine-in service alongside a patio. Touring cyclists will find a familiar, reliable stop with a broad menu covering breakfast, lunch, and dinner.

address.value: 7519 Market Crossing CRU13, Burnaby, BC V5J 0A3

enrichment_extras.reasoning: Website content for the Burnaby (Marine and Byrne) location fully corroborates the OSM record: phone 604-431-5100 and email unit163@whitespot.ca both match. The website explicitly lists 'Take Out,' 'Order Take Out,' curbside pickup, and third-party delivery services as amenities, confirming takeout. OSM tags internet_access=wlan but the website does not mention Wi-Fi for guests, so that amenity stays null per the rules. No bike parking, washroom, or water-refill information appears anywhere in the website content or OSM tags.
concerns: OSM tags internet_access=wlan but the location-specific website page makes no mention of guest Wi-Fi; amenity left null pending confirmation.
OSM address omits the unit identifier (CRU13) and postal code present on the website; address updated to the fuller website version.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, open, publicly accessible chain restaurant with confirmed takeout — a useful stop for touring cyclists seeking a full meal.
